mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 PM, here is today is balanced dish. It is 94 degrees and partly cloudy near Verona Area High School with an air quality index of 58. We are currently under a Waxing Gibbous moon, though there are no visible ISS passes tonight. Overnight, temperatures will dip to 71 degrees and we are expecting some rain.

The City has officially closed submissions for the I Voted sticker contest, where students from grades K through 12 submitted designs for the November election. Residents can participate by voting on the top designs from July 28 through August 7. Also, the Public Works department reminds residents to inspect their mailboxes before winter, as the City has a specific policy for damage caused by snow plows.

There is plenty to do in Verona! Today, you can catch live music at Bailey is Run Vineyard or Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, join a yoga session at Insight Wellness, and early next week brings trivia nights at Hop Haus Brewing, Wisconsin Brewing Company, Paddy Mac is, and The Bogey Factory, plus the downtown Farmers Market on Tuesday.
Looking at the police report from July 13, officers responded to a situation where a 36-year-old driver was arrested for an O-W-I after getting his vehicle stranded on a large rock.
Today is the perfect day for a scoop of OREO Cookie Overload. The shop is open until 10 PM, so there is still plenty of time to stop by for a treat.
